result.name: Order Net Sales
result.description: The order net sales. Equates to gross sales - discounts - returns. Pending and unpaid orders are included. Test, canceled, and deleted orders aren't included.

result.name: Order New or Returning Customer
result.description: Whether the customer was new or returning at the time of the order, based on the number of orders the customer had placed: 'new' for their first order, 'returning' otherwise.

result.name: Order note
result.description: An optional note that a shop owner can attach to the order.

result.name: Order Original Price
result.description: The total price of the order at the time of order creation.

result.name: Order Original Price (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total price of the order at creation in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Original Total Additional Fees Amount
result.description: The total amount of additional fees at the time of order creation.

result.name: Order Original Total Additional Fees (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total additional fees on the order at creation in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Original Total Duties Amount
result.description: The total amount of duties before returns, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Original Total Duties (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total duties charged on the order at creation in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Payment Methods (Gateways)
result.description: A list of the names of all payment gateways used for the order.

result.name: Order Payment References
result.description: The payment references sent to the payment gateways for the order's transactions, comma-separated. Includes captures, refunds and failed payment attempts.

result.name: Order PO Number
result.description: The PO number associated with the order.

result.name: Order Presentment Currency
result.description: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the currency the buyer used when placing the order. Together with the shop currency and a presentment amount it yields the FX rate applied to the order.

result.name: Order Processed At
result.description: The date and time when the order was processed.

result.name: Line Item Product Price
result.description: The product price of this line item.

result.name: Order Items Quantity
result.description: The sum of the quantities for all line items that contribute to the order's current subtotal price.

result.name: Order Refund Discrepancy Amount
result.description: The difference between the suggested and actual refund amount of all refunds that have been applied to the order. A positive value indicates a difference in the merchant's favor, and a negative value indicates a difference in the customer's favor.

result.name: Order Refund Discrepancy Amount (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The difference between the refunded amount and the returned amount, in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Refund Note
result.description: The notes (reasons) attached to the order's refunds, semicolon-separated when there is more than one refund.

result.name: Order Refundable
result.description: Whether the order can be refunded.

result.name: Order Refunds
result.description: Id of refund assigned to the order.

result.name: Aggregated Order Refunds Net
result.description: (Equates to order_gross_sales - order_total_discounts - order_net_sales).

result.name: Order refunded items quantity
result.description: Total quantity of refunded items.

result.name: Order Refunds total
result.description: The order total refunds.

result.name: Aggregated Order Refunds Total Tax
result.description: The total tax on the refund line items.

result.name: Order Registered Source URL
result.description: The URL of the source that the order originated from, if found in the domain registry.

result.name: Order Requires Shipping
result.description: Whether the order has shipping lines or at least one line item on the order that requires shipping.

result.name: Order Restockable
result.description: Whether any line item on the order can be restocked.

result.name: Order Retail Location Name
result.description: The name of the physical location where a retail order is created or completed.

result.name: Order Return Status
result.description: The order's aggregated return status for display purposes.

result.name: Order returned items value
result.description: The order total returned items value.

result.name: Order returned items quantity
result.description: The order total returned items quantity.

result.name: Order Sales Channel (A duplicate of `order_app_name`)
result.description: The name of the application.

result.name: Order Shipping Address
result.description: The orders shipping address.

result.name: Order Shipping Address City
result.description: The orders shipping address city.

result.name: Order Shipping Address Country
result.description: The orders shipping address country.

result.name: Order Shipping Address Phone
result.description: The orders shipping address phone number.

result.name: Order Shipping Address Province
result.description: The orders shipping address province.

result.name: Order Shipping Address Zip
result.description: The orders shipping address zip or postal code.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Amount
result.description: The pre-tax shipping price without any discounts applied, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Carrier Identifier
result.description: A reference to the carrier service that provided the rate. Present when the rate was computed by a third-party carrier service.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Code
result.description: A reference to the shipping method.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Delivery Category
result.description: The general classification of the delivery method.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Discounted Amount
result.description: The shipping price after applying discounts, in shop currency. If the order_taxes_included field is true, then this price includes taxes. If not, it's the pre-tax price.

result.name: Order Shipping Line ID
result.description: A globally-unique ID for this shipping line.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Is Custom
result.description: Whether the shipping line is custom or not.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Is Removed
result.description: Whether the shipping line has been removed.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Phone
result.description: The phone number on the orders shipping line (delivery method). For the shipping address phone, use Order Shipping Address Phone.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Shipping Rate Handle
result.description: A unique identifier for the shipping rate. The format can change without notice and isn't meant to be shown to users.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Source
result.description: The rate source for this shipping line.

result.name: Order Shipping Line Title
result.description: The title of this shipping line.

result.name: Order Shipping Price (with taxes)
result.description: The shipping price without taxes, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Shipping Price
result.description: The pre-tax shipping price without any discounts applied, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Shipping Tax
result.description: The pre-tax shipping price without any discounts applied, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Source Identifier
result.description: A unique POS or third party order identifier.

result.name: Order Source Name
result.description: The name of the source (sales channel or POS) where the order originated, for example 'web', 'pos', or an app handle.

result.name: Order Subtotal Price
result.description: The sum of the prices for all line items after discounts and before returns, in shop currency. If order_taxes_included is true, then the subtotal also includes tax.

result.name: Order Subtotal Price (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The sum of line item prices after discounts and before returns, in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order tags
result.description: Tags attached to the order

result.name: Order Tax Exempt
result.description: Whether taxes are exempt on the order.

result.name: Order Taxes Included
result.description: Whether taxes are included in the subtotal price of the order.

result.name: Order Is Test
result.description: Whether the order is a test. Test orders are made using the Shopify Bogus Gateway or a payment provider with test mode enabled.

result.name: Order Total Capturable Amount
result.description: The authorized amount that's uncaptured or undercaptured, in shop currency. This amount isn't adjusted for returns.

result.name: Order Total Capturable (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total amount that can be captured on the order in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Total Placed Order Count
result.description: The number of all placed orders (including orders with refunds). This value is displayed in Orders report.

result.name: Order Total Discount Cart
result.description: The total order-level discount amount, before returns, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Total Discounts
result.description: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in the shop currency.

result.name: Order Total Discounts (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Total Discounts Set
result.description: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in shop currency. This includes both order and line level discounts.

result.name: Order Total Outstanding Amount
result.description: The total amount not yet transacted for the order, in shop currency. A positive value indicates a difference in the merchant's favor (payment from customer to merchant) and a negative value indicates a difference in the customer's favor (refund from merchant to customer).

result.name: Order Total Outstanding (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total outstanding (unpaid) amount on the order in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Total Price
result.description: The current total price of the order, after returns.This includes taxes and discounts.

result.name: Order Total Price Amount
result.description: The total price of the order, before returns.This includes taxes and discounts.

result.name: Order Total Price (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total price of the order, before returns, in the customer's presentment currency. Includes taxes and discounts.

result.name: Order Total Shipping Price
result.description: The total shipping amount before discounts and returns, in the shop currency.

result.name: Order Total Shipping Price (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total shipping amount before discounts and returns in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Total Shipping Refunded Price
result.description: The total amount of shipping that was refunded, in the shop currency.

result.name: Order Total Shipping Refunded Price (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total amount of shipping that was refunded in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Total Tax Amount
result.description: The total tax amount before returns, in shop currency.

result.name: Order Total Tax (Presentment Currency)
result.description: The total taxes charged on the order in the customer's presentment currency.

result.name: Order Unpaid
result.description: Whether no payments have been made for the order.

result.name: Order Updated At
result.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was last modified.

result.name: Order User ID
result.description: The ID of the user logged into Shopify POS who processed the order, if applicable.

result.name: Payout Amount
result.description: The net amount of the payout in the payout currency.

result.name: Payout Currency
result.description: The currency of the payout amount.

result.name: Payout Date
result.description: The date the payout was issued (funds settled to the bank).

result.name: Shopify Payout ID
result.description: The ID of the Shopify Payments payout (bank settlement).

result.name: Shopify Payout Status
result.description: The transfer status of the payout (e.g. PAID, SCHEDULED).

result.name: Marketing Event Preview URL
result.description: The preview URL of the event.

result.name: Product Created At Datetime
result.description: The date and time the product was created.

result.name: Product Description
result.description: Description of the product.

result.name: Product handle
result.description: The product handle.

result.name: Product ID
result.description: Unique identifier for the product.

result.name: Product Image URL
result.description: The image URL of the product.

result.name: Product Inventory Quantity
result.description: The product quantity in inventory.

result.name: Product Inventory Value
result.description: The sell value of the product inventory.

result.name: Product Metafield Created At
result.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was last updated.

result.name: Product Metafield Description
result.description: The description of the metafield.

result.name: Product Metafield ID
result.description: The unique ID of the metafield.

result.name: Product Metafield Key
result.description: The unique identifier for a metafield within its namespace.

result.name: Product Metafield Namespace
result.description: The container for a group of metafields that the metafield is or will be associated with.

result.name: Product Metafield Owner ID
result.description: The unique ID of the resource that the metafield is attached to.

result.name: Product Metafield Owner Resource
result.description: The type of resource that the metafield is attached to.

result.name: Product Metafield Type
result.description: The type of data that is stored in the metafield.

result.name: Product Metafield Updated At
result.description: The type of resource that the metafield is attached to.

result.name: Product Metafield Value
result.description: The data stored in the metafield. Always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.

result.name: Product Price
result.description: The price of the product.

result.name: Product published at datetime
result.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was published. Can be null if unpublished.

result.name: (Deprecated) Product published scope
result.description: (Deprecated) No longer available via the Shopify API for this app; always null. Previously indicated whether the product was published to the Point of Sale channel (global) or web only.

result.name: Product status
result.description: The status of the product (active/archived/draft).

result.name: Product Tags
result.description: Tags attached to the product.

result.name: Product Template Suffix
result.description: The suffix of the Liquid template used for the product page.

result.name: Product Title
result.description: The title of the product.

result.name: Product Type
result.description: The type of the product.

result.name: Product Updates At Datetime
result.description: The date and time when the product was last modified.

result.name: Product Variant Barcode
result.description: The barcode, UPC, or ISBN number for the product.

result.name: Product Variant Compare At Price
result.description: The original price of the item before an adjustment or a sale.

result.name: Product Variant Created At
result.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product variant was created.

result.name: (Deprecated) Product Variant Grams
result.description: The weight of the product variant in grams.

result.name: Product Variant ID
result.description: The unique numeric identifier for the product variant.

result.name: Product Variant Available Quantity At Location
result.description: Units that can be sold at this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Committed Quantity At Location
result.description: Units part of placed orders but not yet fulfilled at this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Damaged Quantity At Location
result.description: On hand units not sellable due to damage at this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Incoming Quantity At Location
result.description: Units on their way to this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Cost
result.description: Unit cost associated with the inventory item. Note: the user must have 'View product costs' permission granted in order to access this field once product granular permissions are enabled.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Country Code Of Origin
result.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of where the item originated from.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Created At
result.description: The date and time when the inventory item was created.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item harmonized System Code
result.description: The harmonized system code of the item.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item ID
result.description: The unique identifier for the inventory item, which is used in the Inventory API to query for inventory information.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Province Code Of Origin
result.description: The ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 province code of where the item originated from.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Tracked
result.description: Whether inventory levels are tracked for the item.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Requires Shipping
result.description: Whether the inventory item requires shipping.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item SKU
result.description: Inventory item SKU.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Item Updated
result.description: The date and time when the inventory item was updated.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Location ID
result.description: The unique identifier of the location the stock is held at. Selecting a per-location field returns one row per (variant, location), so variant-level metrics (e.g. Product Variant Inventory Quantity) repeat across those rows and should not be summed.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Location Name
result.description: The name of the location the stock is held at. Requires the read_locations access scope. Selecting a per-location field returns one row per (variant, location), so variant-level metrics repeat across those rows and should not be summed.

result.name: Product Variant On Hand Quantity At Location
result.description: Total units physically stocked at this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Policy
result.description: Whether customers are allowed (continue) to place an order for the product variant when it's out of stock or not (deny).

result.name: Product Variant Quality Control Quantity At Location
result.description: On hand units in inspection and not sellable at this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Inventory Quantity
result.description: The total sellable quantity of the variant.

result.name: Product Variant Reserved Quantity At Location
result.description: On hand units temporarily set aside at this location. Current stock, not historical.

result.name: Product Variant Safety Stock Quantity At Location
result.description: On hand units held back to guard against overselling. Current stock, not historical.

result.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was last updated.

result.name: Product Variant Metafield Description
result.description: The description of the metafield.

result.description: The unique ID of the metafield.
